svg.aria-label: The neural network of PneumoShift with nodes and weights
svg.text: Every line is a real weight of our trained model: blue = positive, orange = negative, thicker = stronger. Node brightness = how strongly that part of the network responds to this X-ray.
Simplified: a sample of the feature maps is shown, and between two stages one line stands for one 3 × 3 filter (9 weights) of the next stage's first layer. The last layer is complete.
